bio: Adjacent to Montréal Plaza, Juliette Plaza is a small restaurant with some 20 seats and a unique interior featuring eye-catching wallpapered ceiling panels, a suspended boat, and Asterix comic strips framed on the walls. The chefs serve up flavourful modern cuisine, which, although simpler than the food served in the main restaurant, has bags of personality – a cone of delicious fish tartare or the tender slow-braised beef chuck. Table d'hôte menu served in the evening.
